extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and toolbar.

extDescription.message: Reads your TrainingPeaks body metrics through your own logged-in session — no password, no API key — and hands them to the Kaiord editor.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store.

checking.description: Status verdict while the popup probes the session.

checkingCause.description: Status cause sentence shown while the probe runs.

connected.description: Status verdict when the TrainingPeaks session can mint a token.

connectedCause.message: Reading your body metrics through your session.
connectedCause.description: Status cause sentence for the connected state.

notSignedIn.description: Status verdict when the TrainingPeaks session cannot mint a token.

notSignedInCause.message: Sign in at trainingpeaks.com once — the bridge mints its token from that session, no password stored.
notSignedInCause.description: Status cause sentence explaining how to establish a session.

captionFeeds.description: Caption above the capability chips in the connected state.

captionWillFeed.description: Caption above the capability chips before the bridge is connected.

typeWeight.description: Capability chip for the Weight data type imported into Kaiord.

typeWeightBack.description: Capability chip for the Weight push-back this bridge supports but that no Kaiord export route drives yet; shown dashed under "Will feed Kaiord".

openEditor.description: Footer link that opens the Kaiord editor.

signInTrainingPeaks.description: Primary footer link that fixes a missing TrainingPeaks session.

openTrainingPeaks.description: Secondary footer link opening app.trainingpeaks.com in a new tab.

refresh.description: Accessible label for the header refresh button.
